correctness.rationale: For arbitrary spin assignments, the within-clique energy is one-half the sum of squared row sums less n(n-1)/2; the reversal-edge energy equals -n(n-1)/2+M+4b. This yields an exact energy decomposition with nonnegative 4b. Minimization over the parity-constrained row values gives the listed levels and ties. For every permitted nonnegative plateau, a k-regular graph and Eulerian orientation of its even-degree complement realize every row sum k with b=0. For even n at 0<=h/J<=1, global inversion permits M>=0 and gives the sharp baseline bound, achieved by a perfect-matching and balanced orientation. At n odd h=0, equality forces row sums zero. The only omitted quantity is general exact degeneracy. The independent integer-mask checker enumerates all configurations n=3,4,5 and passes 80 assertions; infinite n follows from the proof, not the experiments.
